description: This file implements a backend for Git's reference management system using the filesystem. It manages reading, locking, updating, pruning, and rewriting references and reflogs, supporting operations such as renaming, copying, and optimizing reference storage. It also handles repository-specific configurations, reference caches, and filesystem interactions including directory traversal and concurrency control.

classes.name: ref_lock
classes.description: Represents a lock on a reference, containing reference name, lock file info, old object ID, and user count.
